description: Defines the Player enum class with two constants (X and O) and a helper method to get the next player in turn order, used in a Tic Tac Toe game.

classes.name: Player
classes.description: An enum class representing the two players in the game, with a method to cycle to the next player.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the other player (O if current is X, or X if current is O).
